fusions.name: Gentle Press
fusions.desc: A slow swell that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Anything struck moves 16% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Squeeze
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slack Tide
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 6 tiles in place for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, healing you receives is 40% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
